author: _Nathy
body:
Hello Support,


My name is resepignev, lesser known as Actyon_.


I would like to appeal my recent punishment for "Troll Staff Application" that was issued on April 3rd, 2016 at 2:03 AM. The ban will run out in two weeks on the 17th April.


Yes, I admit I submitted a staff application with my alternate account called Actyon_.

I did not submit the application with intent to troll, I rather tried to see if I still can write an application and get accepted. You can see that by reading the application. I filled the format out like I really want to be a moderator (I did not write jokes or anything like that).


Now to my next point, where does it say that joke applications are not allowed? I read through all threads and couldn't find any word regarding troll or joke applications.

After I addressed this in the moderators chat I was shut down with the argument of common sense.

Yes it's right it is common sense but some people lack common sense (like Iron said). What is with these people, do they also get punished?

This brings me to the next thing. As we all know Zac likes to argue that you can't punish him because it was never written down. And as far as I know Micheal (Newcleus) liked to use that argument too before he was a staff member again. (Additional point that proves the issue with Zac: http://prntscr.com/anewt0)


Another point I want to address is that a specific player called Ihze also made a troll/joke application and was not punished. Since I'm a moderator I was obviously abled to read the application, furthermore he copy and pasted the application off the internet (as MasterProX said). I don't really expect that he is going to get web temp-banned for the next two weeks, but I would rather suggest an appeal for my ban.


Now I would like to address the length of my ban. The ban will approximately last for the next two weeks. This length, according to the punishment guidelines is equal to "Racism/Creating Racist Threads"  on the forums.  I would say that creating a supposed "Joke" Staff Application is not equal to have such behavior/creating such threads on the forums. Especially since my application wasn't intended to harm anyone or slow things down.


On a side note according to the current punishment guidelines you should archive the post and warn me if necessary. Which also it prepended at almost every forum punishment. Overall I would creating a "fake/troll/joke" application rather classify as "Trolling" since the punishment already has "Troll" in it or as "Forum Spamming/Threads/Posts". As I explained above the intend of harming or actual trolling wasn't given I would go with the second option (Forum Spamming/Threads/Posts). This being said it would warrant a warn, even without the warn it does not stand in any relation to a 14 day Web Tempban.


And before you say "The guidelines are just guidelines", some of my punishments were appealed because the player said I was too harsh/didn't follow the guidelines. Sadly I can't name any player names since I can't check their infractions (because they are deleted) and I don't really know the player names anymore (since it happened more than a few times). (This is also connected to TS appeals).


Since I don't expect any special treatment since I'm not negotiating on TS, Slack or obviously the forums (because I'm banned).

I hope you reconsider the punishment and discuss it together in a senior staff meeting/senior staff slack chat.


If the ban isn't going to be lifted I want to say "Thank you" that you let me take a little break from moderating the forums.

I also want to mention that I'm still have an open LoA post with an open date (no set date yet). I also try to be active on Slack, TS and ingame even when I'm on leave of Absence. I also would wish if we could move the appeal to the staff slack since it'll be easier to reply to each other.


I might be missing out on some points since it's 2 AM. Please bear with me :)


Regards Flo/resepignev :)

title: Web tempban for Flo/resepignev

replies.author: Fouled
replies.body:
Hello,

I know that i'm repeating myself by saying this but the rule of "joke staff applications" was not only made during this application process. I understand what you're trying to say here, "You can see that by reading the application. I filled the format out like I really want to be a moderator (I did not write jokes or anything like that)." But that doesn't really matter, you're already a moderator... I don't see why you would make a staff application, it's really not necessary. To me, it seems immature.

I do not believe it said that joke application weren't allowed on any current thread, but we've addressed this many times in the past as well. As a moderator, you should already know that they aren't allowed. You also told me that you wrote the staff application just because you were bored.

You will have to wait out your temp forum ban as this appeal is denied.

Regards,
Fouled
